topics.name: Motion graphics
topics.blurb: Reels, kinetic type, title cards and explainers — in code or with video models.
searches: motion graphics AI workflow new technique
image to video model new release camera control
agent skill motion graphics Remotion Claude

tests.prompt: Make a 6-second 9:16 kinetic-type intro for a reel titled "AI made this poster in 30 seconds". Deliver a beat sheet and one self-contained Remotion component (TypeScript) for it.
tests.good: Hook in the first second; every text hold long enough to read; key text inside the reels safe area; eased motion, no linear moves; component would render without edits.

tests.prompt: Plan a 20-second product explainer reel for a note-taking app with three features. Deliver the beat sheet with timings in seconds and frames, on-screen text, motion and sound cues.
tests.good: One idea per beat; timings add up to 20 s at 30 fps; readable text holds; a clear hook and a closing call to action; sound cues on beat changes.

tests.prompt: I have a finished event poster as a still image. Write the image-to-video prompts and settings to turn it into a clean 5-second seamless loop for Instagram, keeping the poster text perfectly legible.
tests.good: Keeps text out of the generative model (or protects it); one camera move; describes the motion and what stays still; explains how to make and trim the loop.

topics.name: AI posters
topics.blurb: Posters, event graphics and consistent social series with image models.
searches: image generation model text rendering update
agent skill poster design image generation
consistent character style reference image model
AI graphic design workflow Canva Figma new

tests.prompt: Write the prompt for a 4:5 Instagram poster announcing a free two-day AI workshop in Kochi on 12 October. The headline must read exactly "AI IN TWO DAYS".
tests.good: Correct aspect ratio; composition leaves room for text; exact headline handled safely; palette given as hex; date and place legible; a clear call to action.

tests.prompt: Plan a series of three launch posters for a new filter-coffee brand that must look like one family. Give the shared style block and the three prompts.
tests.good: A reusable style block used word for word; only the subject changes; a shared layout grid; a way to keep colour and grain consistent.

tests.prompt: A client needs an A3 print poster with an 8-line event schedule. Describe the workflow and write the image prompt.
tests.good: Generates the image without text and sets the schedule in a layout tool; right print size, bleed and resolution; upscaling and proofing steps; a spelling check.

topics.name: Websites
topics.blurb: Landing pages and small sites built with AI coding tools.
searches: web performance accessibility new best practice

tests.prompt: Build a single-file landing page (HTML and CSS) for a home bakery in Kochi taking pre-orders for Onam.
tests.good: Concrete hero headline and one clear action; real, specific copy; works at 360px; accessible contrast and focus states; does not look like a generic AI template.

tests.prompt: Write the section plan and all the copy for a landing page for an AI invoice-scanning app for small shops.
tests.good: Each section has a job; the headline states the outcome; proof and objections handled; one repeated call to action; no vague filler phrases.

tests.prompt: Improve this hero: 'Welcome to our website. We provide innovative solutions for your business needs.' Deliver new hero copy plus the HTML and CSS.
tests.good: Specific outcome in under 10 words; one verb-led button; tokens for type and colour; responsive; clearly better than the original.
